an4.67:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagava Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
an4.67:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena Sāvatthiyaṃ aññataro bhikkhu ahinā daṭṭho kālakato hoti.
an4.67:1.3: Atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. Ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū Bhagavantaṃ etad avocuṃ:-- 2.
an4.67:1.4: Idha bhante Sāvatthiyaṃ aññataro bhikkhu ahinā daṭṭho kālakato ti.
an4.67:2.1: Na ha nūna so bhikkhave bhikkhu cattāri ahirājakulāni mettena cittena phari,
an4.67:2.2: sace hi so bhikkhave bhikkhu cattāri ahirājakulāni mettena cittena phareyya na hi so bhikkhave bhikkhu ahinā daṭṭho kālaṃ kareyya.
an4.67:3.2: Virūpakkhaṃ ahirājakulaṃ, Erāpathaṃ ahirājakulaṃ, Chabyāputtaṃ ahirājakulaṃ, Kaṇhāgotamakaṃ ahirājakulaṃ.
an4.67:3.3: Na ha nūna so bhikkhave bhikkhu imāni cattāri ahirājakulāni mettaṃ cittena phari,
an4.67:4.1: Anujānāmi bhikkhave imāni cattāri ahirājakulāni mettena cittena pharituṃ attaguttiyā attarakkhāya attaparittāyāti. 3.
